marta: Leaving a quick handoff — I'm OOO tomorrow 06:00-10:00 PT. Need someone to cover the morning rota. Main risks to watch:
- redis-kv prefetch spikes (~10:30-11:30 PT)
- autoscaler 503s when burst > 2.5k req/min
- RT degradation on b3 nodes suspected preemptions
- noisy model-fallback alerts (low-severity but high-volume)

marta: TL;DR: If you see repeated redis timeouts or 'prefetch_retries' > 5/min, restart prefetcher pool: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prefetcher` and escalate to eng-runtime.

ryan: I can cover 06:30-09:30 PT. ping me @alex if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

alex: quick Q — do we have a runbook for the autoscaler 503 pattern? last time it was a tarpit from ephemeral instances.

marta: yes, runbook -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-503 (short steps: 1) check scale events `kubectl get hpa -n inference` 2) look for node preemptions in cloud logs 3) temporarily bump maxReplicas by +20% if scaling backpressure)

oncall-bot: Scheduled handover recorded: marta -> ryan (06:30-09:30 PT). Reminder set at 06:25 PT.

sara: FYI the 'model-fallback' alert is noisy — threshold tuned low. If it's spamming, mute for 30m: `/alert mute model-fallback -m 30` (ops only). Also check `fallback_rate` on the model-dashboard.

ryan: got it. If we need to mute, I'll coordinate with eng-platform. Also will watch `kv_cache_evictions` (query in dashboard tile).

alex: paste of helpful queries if needed:
```
# prefetched retries
sum(rate(prefetch_retries_total[5m])) by (instance)
# KV evictions
sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))
```

marta: Note: if kv_evictions spike > 200/min that's usually due to the recent rollout of quantized LLM shims (ticket INF-2217). Restarting the prefetcher fixes it 80% of the time, otherwise escalate to eng-ml.

ryan: thanks, I'll keep an eye. leaving note in the rota doc.

marta: thanks! I've added a short checklist in the rota doc and linked the runbooks. Back on call at 10:00 PT, ping me if you need a hand. :waves:
